scope_notes: Disposable charter/research/cash and controlled settlement fixtures; not natural research, balance or profit evidence.
Chartered Florence and independent Bardi were entered as separate normal player roles. Existing independent agreements were funded under the earlier Florence controller before detachment.
Eight accepted operators and immutable terms were inspected by scrolling the native ledger. Future terms were changed with ordinary controls.
Native human Accept, Decline and selector cancellation were clicked normally. Stale/expired offer rejections are native assertion evidence, not separately reproduced manual UI observations.
Capital/profit/loss are controlled display fixtures; natural exploration and trade receipts are evidenced separately in the engine reports.

Intermediate captures retain their actual hashes. Final source changes after 88970853 are only a safe numeric default in offer-generation preview; financial settlement, accounting, layout and art remain identical.
The initial 3930ee55 UI revealed a blue locked Offer and a swallowed # suffix. The final guard and clean headings were cold-loaded and inspected. Superseded development screenshots are not included.
Preview diagnostics were reviewed separately from baseline startup warnings. No claim is made that all native startup diagnostics are absent.
Other languages, resolutions/scales and release-wide campaigns retain M10 gates.
